login.ext.denied: The extension refused or did not respond.
login.ro.title: Read-only
login.ro.label: Identifier

login.ro.nip05fail: NIP-05 address not found or unreachable.
login.nsec: Private key refused: this client never accepts one. The field was cleared.

login.connected.nip07: Signed in with the signing extension.
feed.global: Global feed, unfiltered. Your following feed is coming soon.
feed.noRelays: No relay reachable. Check your connection or add a relay in Settings.
settings.relays.label: Add a relay (wss://…)

settings.relays.exists: This relay is already in the list.
feed.followingEmpty: No recent notes from your follows on your relays.
feed.noFollows: No follow list found on your relays: only your own notes are shown.
profile.copyFail: Copy failed: select and copy the npub by hand.
profile.follow.empty: No follow list found on your relays. If you have one elsewhere, it would be overwritten. Tap again to confirm.
profile.noNotes: No notes found on your relays.
profile.noFollows: This account follows nobody (or the list was not found).
profile.noFollowers: No followers found on your relays.

login.bunker.label: Signer link
login.bunker.hint: Paste a bunker://… link or a signer NIP-05 address. Your private key stays in the signer.
login.bunker.waiting: Connecting to the signer… approve the request in your app.
login.bunker.noRelays: No usable relay in this link (public wss:// required).
login.bunker.timeout: The signer did not answer in time.
login.bunker.failed: Could not connect to the signer.
login.bunker.unsupported: This library version does not support NIP-46.
login.nc.or: Or start the connection from this client:
login.nc.hint: Open this link in your signing app, or copy it into a web signer.
login.nc.waiting: Waiting for the signer to approve…
login.connected.nip46: Signed in with a remote signer (NIP-46). The session lasts while this tab stays open.
lists.empty: No relay list found for this account on the bootstrap relays.
lists.error: Could not reach the bootstrap relays. Check your connection.
lists.add.label: Add a relay
lists.publish.failed: No relay accepted the publication ({total} tried).
lists.edit.hint: Every change is signed and immediately published to the bootstrap relays and the list's relays.
lists.readonly.hint: Log in with a signer (extension or bunker) to edit your lists.
lists.err.url: Invalid relay address: it must start with wss:// and not point to a local network.
lists.err.dup: This relay is already in the list.
lists.err.last: The last general relay cannot be removed.
lists.err.role: Pick at least read or write.
setup.title: First setup
setup.intro: No relay list is published for this account. Pick the relays to use: they will be published on your account and found again at every login, from any client.
setup.nosigner: No relay list is published for this account, and read-only mode cannot create one. Log in with a signer (extension or bunker) to publish one, or retry if you think it exists.
setup.hint.pub: Relays where you read and publish your notes.
setup.hint.dm: Relays where you receive private messages. Optional. Some require authentication.
setup.err.empty: Pick at least one general relay.
setup.confirm: This is what will be signed and published on your account:
setup.confirm.hint: You can edit these lists at any time in Settings.
compose.label: New note
compose.placeholder: What's up? (#hashtags and nostr:npub… mentions allowed)
compose.reply.label: Your reply
compose.err.private: This text contains a private key (nsec): publication refused.
compose.err.notown: You can only delete your own notes.
compose.norelay: No write relay connected: nothing was published.
note.delete.hint: A deletion request will be sent to relays; it is not guaranteed.
thread.notFound: Note not found on connected relays.
thread.missing: The targeted note was not found.
thread.rootMissing: The thread's original note was not found on connected relays.
pe.intro: Empty fields are removed from your profile; unknown fields are kept. The profile is published to your relays and the bootstrap relays.
pe.intro.new: No profile found: this one will be created.
pe.name: Username
pe.nip05.hint: Format name@domain; the domain must list you.
pe.unavailable: Could not read your current profile: no relay connected. Try again later so it isn't overwritten.
settings.signer.unknown: to be checked on first use (remote signer)
settings.signer.nip44.missing: Your signer does not expose NIP-44 encryption: private messages will not be available. Update it or use a compatible signer (Nostash, recent Alby, Clave, Amber…).
login.sameDevice: On the same phone as your signer app (Clave, Amber…), prefer the bunker:// link: nostrconnect:// is fragile because the phone suspends the browser when you switch apps. nostrconnect:// mainly suits a signer on another device.
dm.status.nosigner: Your signer does not support NIP-44 encryption: private messages are unavailable. Sign in again with a compatible signer.
dm.status.norelays: No messaging relay is configured. Add some in Settings (private messaging relays).
dm.status.denied: The signer refused decryption: new messages are not being read. Allow NIP-44 encryption in your signer, then retry.
dm.new.label: New conversation (npub, nprofile or NIP-05 address)
dm.sent: Sent: {ok}/{total} recipient relays accepted the message.
dm.error.NO_DM_RELAYS: This contact has not published messaging relays: you cannot message them privately.
dm.error.NO_NIP44: Your signer does not support NIP-44.
dm.error.SIGNER: The signer refused or did not respond.
dm.error.FAILED: No recipient relay accepted the message.
dm.privacy: Decrypted messages stay on this device and are erased when you log out.
